title: gerascanthus calophyllus
intro: Gerascanthus calophyllus, commonly known as the beautyberry or beauty bush, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
